description: Ports is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by PortWatch. This dataset shows the satellite-based vessel data from the UN Global Platform, this monitor provides real-time indicators of port and shipment activity for the ports. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
